# 科技樹

科技樹節點通過花費**研究點數**(從內核獲得——見功能區的[Research](/zh-TW/features/research/))解鎖物品。只有當其**父**節點已解鎖且已學習**啟動擴展**時,節點才能解鎖。點數類型:common、hitech、industrial、newtech、nuimqol、pelistal、thelodica。

## 分類

每個類別有包含完整樹與每節點一頁的自己的頁面。

| Category | Nodes | Root lines | What it unlocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ Nuimqol (faction) ](/zh-TW/content/techtree/groups/nuimqol/) | 87 | 3 | Research for the Nuimqol rebel faction: its named weapons and the modules that fight alongside them. |
| [ Pelistal (faction) ](/zh-TW/content/techtree/groups/pelistal/) | 91 | 3 | Research for the Pelistal domain faction: its named weapons and the modules that fight alongside them. |
| [ Thelodica (faction) ](/zh-TW/content/techtree/groups/thelodica/) | 87 | 3 | Research for the Thelodica Clan faction: its named weapons and the modules that fight alongside them. |
| [ Common (first set) ](/zh-TW/content/techtree/groups/common1/) | 78 | 4 | The first set of standard (non-faction) modules available to every player. |
| [ PBS structures ](/zh-TW/content/techtree/groups/pbs/) | 84 | 1 | Power base station capsules and construction modules — the buildings of open-world corporate play. |
| [ Industrial ](/zh-TW/content/techtree/groups/indy/) | 67 | 3 | Industrial research: reactor boosters and the modules that keep production lines moving. |
| [ Common (second set) ](/zh-TW/content/techtree/groups/common2/) | 169 | 4 | The second set of standard modules, including the named energy-transfer lines. |
